question: If sec 2θ = cosec (θ – 36°), where 2θ is an acute angle, find the value of θ.
solution:
**Given:**

sec 2θ = cosec (θ – 36°)

**Concept used:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e073e32ec4277aef5655b4d655ab3a661e66eccec51056b97671ba3a40e241b9.png] 

**Calculation:**

sec 2θ = cosec (θ – 36°)

⇒ sec 2θ = sec (90° – θ + 36°)

⇒ sec 2θ = sec (126° – θ)

⇒ 2θ = 126° – θ

⇒ 3θ = 126°

⇒ θ = 42°

**∴ The required answer is 42°.**
